title: Anasarca

inlines.v: ANAS'ARCA, noun [Gr. in or between, and flesh.] A species of dropsy, from a serous humor spread between the skin and flesh; or an accumulation of lymph in the cellular membrane, occasioning a soft, pale, inelastic swelling of the skin.
